package main

// This process has no GoDj dependency. All requests and responses use the
// client generated from the running model-resource application's document.
import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	sdk "example.com/godj-openapi-client/inventoryapi"
)

type target struct {
	URL string `json:"url"`
}
type receipt struct {
	Checks  []string         `json:"checks"`
	Rows    map[string]int64 `json:"rows"`
	Evolved bool             `json:"evolved"`
	Race    bool             `json:"race"`
}

type security string

func (value security) BearerAuth(context.Context, sdk.OperationName) (sdk.BearerAuth, error) {
	return sdk.BearerAuth{Token: string(value)}, nil
}

type transport struct {
	base   *http.Transport
	status atomic.Int64
}

func (value *transport) RoundTrip(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	response, err := value.base.RoundTrip(request)
	if response != nil {
		value.status.Store(int64(response.StatusCode))
	}
	return response, err
}

func main() {
	result, err := run()
	if err != nil {
		// Only fixed stages leave the process. URLs, tokens and response bodies
		// are never diagnostics or a substitute for the completion receipt.
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result); err != nil {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func stage(name string) error { return errors.New(name) }

func run() (receipt, error) {
	var input target
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 4096))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&input); err != nil || input.URL == "" {
		return receipt{}, stage("fixture input")
	}
	var trailing any
	if !errors.Is(decoder.Decode(&trailing), io.EOF) {
		return receipt{}, stage("fixture framing")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	base := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	base.Proxy = nil
	defer base.CloseIdleConnections()
	observed := &transport{base: base}
	httpClient := &http.Client{Transport: observed, Timeout: 5 * time.Second}
	makeClient := func(token string) (*sdk.Client, error) {
		return sdk.NewClient(input.URL, security(token), sdk.WithClient(httpClient))
	}
	malformed, err := makeClient("")
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, stage("malformed client")
	}
	// The required security source always writes a Bearer header. An empty
	// token is malformed syntax, not an absent Authorization field.
	denied, err := malformed.InventoryCreate(ctx, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "malformed"})
	badRequest, ok := denied.(*sdk.InventoryCreateBadRequest)
	if err != nil || !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusBadRequest || badRequest.Response.Code != "not_authenticated" || !strings.Contains(badRequest.WWWAuthenticate.Value, "invalid_request") {
		return receipt{}, stage("malformed credentials")
	}
	result := receipt{Evolved: evolved, Race: raceEnabled, Rows: map[string]int64{}}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "malformed_credentials")
	invalidCredentials, err := makeClient("invalid")
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, stage("invalid credentials client")
	}
	denied, err = invalidCredentials.InventoryCreate(ctx, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "unauthorized"})
	unauthorized, ok := denied.(*sdk.InventoryCreateUnauthorized)
	if err != nil || !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusUnauthorized || unauthorized.Response.Code != "not_authenticated" || !strings.Contains(unauthorized.WWWAuthenticate.Value, "invalid_token") {
		return receipt{}, stage("invalid credentials")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "invalid_credentials")
	old, err := makeClient("old")
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, stage("prior client")
	}
	prior, err := old.InventoryCreate(ctx, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "client-old"})
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, stage("prior permission response")
	}
	if evolved {
		if _, ok := prior.(*sdk.InventoryCreateForbidden); !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusForbidden {
			return receipt{}, stage("changed permission")
		}
	} else {
		asset, ok := prior.(*sdk.Asset)
		if !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusCreated || asset.ID <= 0 {
			return receipt{}, stage("baseline permission")
		}
		result.Rows["old"] = asset.ID
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "prior_permission")
	writer, err := makeClient("writer")
	if err != nil {
		return receipt{}, stage("writer client")
	}
	created, err := writer.InventoryCreate(ctx, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "client-def"})
	defaults, ok := created.(*sdk.Asset)
	if err != nil || !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusCreated || defaults.ID <= 0 || defaults.Code != "client-def" || !defaults.Enabled || !defaultProjection(defaults) {
		return receipt{}, stage("model defaults")
	}
	result.Rows["default"] = defaults.ID
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "model_defaults")
	request := &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "   client-value   ", Enabled: sdk.NewOptBool(false), Note: sdk.NewOptNilString("  client note  ")}
	setNewField(request)
	response, err := writer.InventoryCreate(ctx, request)
	value, ok := response.(*sdk.Asset)
	if err != nil || !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusCreated || value.ID <= 0 || value.Enabled || !explicitProjection(value) {
		return receipt{}, stage("typed model write")
	}
	result.Rows["value"] = value.ID
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "typed_write")
	if value.Code != "client-value" {
		return receipt{}, stage("normalized input")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "normalized_input")
	if !slices.Equal(fields(reflect.TypeFor[sdk.Asset]()), responseFields()) {
		return receipt{}, stage("response field change")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "response_projection")
	if !slices.Equal(fields(reflect.TypeFor[sdk.AssetInput]()), requestFields()) || !requestPolicy() {
		return receipt{}, stage("request field change")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "request_projection")
	invalid, err := writer.InventoryCreate(ctx, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "client-too-long-code"})
	if _, ok := invalid.(*sdk.InventoryCreateBadRequest); err != nil || !ok || observed.status.Load() != http.StatusBadRequest {
		return receipt{}, stage("invalid model length")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "invalid_length")
	canceled, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	stop()
	if _, err := writer.InventoryCreate(canceled, &sdk.AssetInput{Code: "canceled"}); !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		return receipt{}, stage("canceled request")
	}
	result.Checks = append(result.Checks, "canceled_request")
	return result, nil
}

func fields(value reflect.Type) []string {
	names := make([]string, value.NumField())
	for index := range names {
		names[index] = value.Field(index).Name
	}
	slices.Sort(names)
	return names
}
